# Bulk Docs

A simple, lightweight, and fast [Docker](https://www.docker.com/) image for [Jekyll](https://jekyllrb.com/) and [Bulk Docs](https://github.com/jgthms/bulk-docs)

## Usage

1. Install the Docker image:

```bash
docker-compose up -d
```

2. Create a new project:

```bash
docker-compose exec docs create
```

3. Access the site at `http://localhost:4000`

## Prerequisites

- [Docker](https://www.docker.com/)
- [Docker Compose](https://docs.docker.com/compose/install/)

### Docker Compose

1. Install Docker Compose:

```bash
curl -sSL https://get.docker.com | sh
```

2. Create a new project:

```bash
docker-compose up -d

```

$ guillaume-gomez
```

```
$ guillaume-gomez new my-project
```

### Customizing

```
$ guillaume-gomez new my-project --custom-config my-config.yaml

```
### Running
```

Behat extension for GuzzleHttpClient

## Installation

Install this extension using the following command:

```bash
composer require michael-k/guzzle-http-client-behat
```

## Usage

Add the following code to your `GuzzleHttp\Client` instance:

```php
$client = new GuzzleHttp\Client();
```

Then you can use the following methods:

```php
$client->get('http://example.com');
$client->post('http://example.com');
$client->put('http://example.com');
$client->patch('http://example.com');
$client->delete('http://example.com');
$client->head('http://example.com');
```

```bash
vendor/bin/phpunit
```

   ```sh
   module github.com/michael-howe/go-chat
   ```

